svg.title: A link to a ticket the filters hide still opens it — SoftTrack web design mockup (#115)
svg.desc: Opening a ticket on a filtered board shows its panel even when the filters exclude it, with one line saying why its card is not on the board. A number with no ticket behind it shows “No such ticket” in the panel, as the ticket page already does.
svg.text: A link to a ticket the filters hide still opens it
· fetched by number, never looked up in the loaded list
Board filtered to Priya; ENG-61 is Daniel’s, and its panel opens anyway
reached from a link in another ticket’s panel

g.text: board › opens a ticket its filters exclude, by number
board › opens a ticket past the first loaded page
board › says “No such ticket” for a number with nothing behind it
board › Clear filters in the panel keeps the panel open
# the first case looks fine by hand, which is why it needs a test:
# it fails the moment the fetch-by-number fallback is removed

svg.text: Done when: the ticket is fetched by identifier, not looked up in the board’s list (already true since #112, BoardPage.tsx:296–306); a number with no ticket says “no such ticket” in
the panel; and a test covers the filtered-out deep link. The “hidden by your filters” line is the one addition, so the open panel explains itself.
